title: StimGen 2.1 study adaptation
description: StimGen adapted by Ilya Capralov for retinal recordings. The release includes the StimGen 2.1 study launcher from commit f1cf0116d5e16c7d91ecea67f4f0be14f2ee3336, its random-number helper, the software environment, the NaV Bifid Stim preset bank with stimulus and calibration files, and change notes. Ben Murphy-Baum wrote the original StimGen.
